prompts.vanguard:
Asset type: production transparent tactical RPG animation sprite sheet. Reference image is the existing Echoes of the Shattered Crown character atlas; preserve the chosen character's face, costume, colors, materials and weapons exactly. Create a NEW sheet for ONLY the chosen character, not the whole party.
Mandatory grid: EXACTLY 4 equal columns and 8 equal rows = 32 full-body frames. Portrait sheet, preferably 1536x2048. Each cell is identical size. No labels, text, lines or grid marks. Genuine RGBA transparency everywhere outside each figure. Keep every weapon, cloth and effect inside its own cell, separated by transparent gutters. Same camera, same character scale and ground baseline across all cells. Standing head near 14% of cell height, ground/soles at 92%, figure centered horizontally. Use the entire rectangular cell for wider action poses; don't crop a weapon. Never put two figures in one cell. Slightly elevated 3/4 front view, looking toward lower right. Crisp, richly detailed illustrated pixel-art fantasy matching the reference, coherent clean outlines, warm parchment/olive/brass palette. Light from upper left. No scene, no ground shadow, no backdrop.
READ ROWS TOP TO BOTTOM, FRAMES LEFT TO RIGHT:
Row 1 IDLE: ready pose, slight inhale, gentle cape settle, exhale ready; subtle four-frame loop.
Row 2 WALK: left foot forward, passing stance, right foot forward, passing stance; clearly alternate legs and arm positions for a loop.
Row 3 ATTACK: windup, extended weapon strike, follow-through, recover. Four DIFFERENT progressive action poses; readable weapon swing.
Row 4 CAST: gather energy, lift hands/weapon, release a small contained spell, recover; four progressive poses.
Row 5 HURT: recoil, stronger recoil, recover, return to ready. Keep character alive.
Row 6 GUARD: raise defense, hold defense, slight breathing while defending, hold. Four poses all defensive.
Row 7 VICTORY: lift weapon/hand, celebratory hold, relaxed smile/settle, ready celebration.
Row 8 DOWNED: stagger/kneel, fall, lying down, lying down settled. Last two frames genuinely horizontal collapsed body at the same ground baseline, not standing.
Do not repeat the same illustration across all frames. Anatomically consistent hands, face and costume throughout. This is a usable animation atlas, not concept art or a contact sheet of different characters.
CHOSEN CHARACTER: Sera's VANGUARD appearance, the silver-haired female knight at TOP LEFT of the reference atlas. Brass-trimmed dark steel plate, ivory tabard, olive cape, steel sword and large shield. ATTACK uses a sword slash; CAST raises sword with small warm golden light; GUARD holds shield in front. Preserve her silver short hair and face.
